description: One Atlas study record by its slug (from search_studies, e.g. "huy-2011") or its DOI: citation, design, setting, strength grade and what it means, Loop parts with verdicts, whether it is about change, Unfrozen's plain-language summary, related studies, the answer pages that cite it, and its unfreeze.us page.

doi.description: The study's DOI, with or without https://doi.org/, for example "10.1002/smj.1124".

slug.description: The study's Atlas slug, for example "vuori-and-huy-2016".

name: get_study
title: Get one Atlas study
